_comment: Golden cases for the agent-profile rules the web client mirrors from the server (src/shared/utils.ts vs server/modules/agent-profiles + server/shared/utils.ts). Both suites run every case, so the two copies cannot drift apart unnoticed: change a rule on one side and a case here fails on the other. valuesRepeat expands to [character, count] repeated.
